guide.minecities.title: Town Guide
guide.minecities.cover:
Living towns: build your own way, the mod recognises your houses and citizens come to live in them.

The village grows into a town, a city, then a megalopolis.
guide.minecities.found.1:
Craft a town hall and place it: you become the mayor.

Rename it in an anvil before placing it to choose the town's name.
guide.minecities.found.2:
Recipe: a bell between two emeralds, a lectern between planks, a chest between planks.

Founded in a village, the town takes in its villagers.
guide.minecities.found.3:
Click the town hall to open its screen: citizens, buildings, registry, council and granary.

The granary is the town's food store.
guide.minecities.house.1:
Build as you like: a closed room (walls, floor, roof), a door and at least one bed.

Each bed houses one citizen.
guide.minecities.house.2:
Hang a house plaque on an inside wall: the house is surveyed.

Green door: registered. Red: a message says what is missing. Click to survey again.
guide.minecities.citizens.1:
Five residents arrive on their own. After that, the town grows through births.

By day they stroll or work; at night they sleep in their beds.
guide.minecities.citizens.2:
They eat from their house's chests, or else from the granary. Starving, they waste away.

Vary their meals: soups, stews and pies make them happy.
guide.minecities.citizens.3:
Happiness from 0 to 10. Happy, they work fast and have children; unhappy for too long, they leave.

Right-click a citizen to see what they lack.
guide.minecities.citizens.4:
Citizens who get along ask to marry: answer in the Registry tab.

Married, fed and with a free bed, they have a child who grows up in three days.
guide.minecities.jobs.1:
A registered building with a vanilla workstation becomes a workshop. Each station employs a citizen.

They often need a tool, from the granary or warehouse.
guide.minecities.jobs.2:
Composter: farmer (hoe)
Smoker: cook
Chopping block (stripped log): lumberjack (axe)
Hay bale: breeder
Barrel by water: fisher (rod)
Furnace: baker
guide.minecities.jobs.3:
Crafting table: builder
Cartography table: courier
Carpenter's bench: carpenter
Stonecutter: mason
Glass kiln: glassblower
Loom: weaver
guide.minecities.jobs.4:
Grindstone: guard (sword)
Fletching table: archer (bow)
Smithing table: inventor
Brewing stand: doctor
Mine winch: miner (pickaxe)
Beehive: beekeeper (shears)
guide.minecities.jobs.5:
Tanning rack: tanner

From town tier:
Lectern: merchant
Blast furnace: smith
Jeweler's bench: jeweler
Chiseled bookshelf: librarian
guide.minecities.build.1:
Take a blueprint at the town hall (Plans tab) and use it on the ground, or type /ville build <blueprint>.

The building's ghost appears: rotate it, then confirm.
guide.minecities.build.2:
Builders clear the ground and place blocks taken from the granary and warehouse. The mayor hears what is missing.

Once finished, the building registers itself.
guide.minecities.build.3:
Four levels: hut, house, hall, mansion. Inside a building, /ville upgrade improves it.

Each level adds beds or a station, and work goes faster.
guide.minecities.storage.1:
A warehouse ledger placed in a registered building makes it the warehouse: its chests are the common store.

Food and emeralds go to the granary.
guide.minecities.storage.2: With couriers, workers leave their output in their workshop: couriers store it and bring builders what they ask for.
guide.minecities.growth.1:
Tiers (residents, houses):
Village
Town: 10 and 4
City: 30 and 12
Megalopolis: 75 and 30

Each tier widens the territory and unlocks jobs.
guide.minecities.growth.2: From city tier, place town hall annexes at least 40 blocks from the town hall: they widen the territory and have their own granary.
guide.minecities.defense.1:
From 8 residents, pillagers may attack at dusk. Guards, archers and the inventor's golems defend the town hall.

A victory brings emeralds.
guide.minecities.defense.2:
Ring a bell on the territory: a two-minute alert. Civilians take shelter, guards rush in, monsters glow.

Ring again to end it.
guide.minecities.council.1:
Festival: 4 emeralds from the granary, everyone dances and is happier for a day.

Decrees: rationing, overtime, holiday (Council tab).
guide.minecities.council.2:
Trade: /ville trade <town>. Once both mayors sign, caravans swap surpluses for emeralds.

A merchant is needed.
